_what: Keys SuperSlicer ACTUALLY REFUSED when it loaded our presets. The SuperSlicer emitters drop these. Measured, not inferred.
_why_not_an_allowlist: The first attempt filtered against an ALLOW-list built from `superslicer --help-fff`, and it silently deleted layer_height from every SuperSlicer preset -- --help-fff lists the CLI-settable subset, not the preset vocabulary, and layer_height is simply not in it. Every 0.2 nozzle row of the slice matrix then failed with "Layer height can't be greater than max layer height", because with no layer_height the slicer used its own default. An allow-list built from an incomplete oracle deletes valid keys and the damage is silent. A deny-list of keys the slicer was OBSERVED to reject cannot over-delete.
_why_not_the_keymap: Deriving foreign keys from keymap.json was tried and is also wrong in both directions: it missed chamber_minimal_temperature, which PrusaSlicer 2.9 DOES define and only SuperSlicer lacks, and it would have dropped compatible_printers and filament_vendor, which both slicers define. The PrusaSlicer family is not one dialect.
_source: tools/slice-harness.py, SuperSlicer 2.7.62.0-beta2, 2026-09-06. Re-derive by reading the REFUSED line of a master-pass run.
_note: Annotation keys (_why_*) are refused too but are handled by prefix in ini_writable(), so they are not repeated here.
_note_brim_type: SuperSlicer has no brim_type. It expresses the same choice as brim_width + brim_width_interior + brim_ears, so the PrusaSlicer key has no counterpart and SuperSlicer warns 'Unknow setting' on it. Confirmed against superslicer --help-fff 2026-09-07.
